en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2795 - In Nawadir of Ibn Abi Umayr, narrated from some of our companions, from one of the Imams (as), it is said
regarding a man performing tawaf who is interrupted by a need:

"There is no harm if he goes to fulfill his own need or someone else's and interrupts his tawaf. Similarly, if he wishes to rest during his tawaf and sit down, there is no harm in doing so. When he returns, he resumes his tawaf from where he left off, even if he had completed less than half of it."
